property_summary: For all callers, calling setOwner(x) from the current owner updates the public owner variable to x; the mutant requiring msg.sender == address(0) prevents legitimate owners from changing owner, so for some caller-address inputs the mutant leaves owner unchanged while the reference updates it.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender == address(0), preventing legitimate owners from calling setOwner and thus leaving owner unchanged after call attempts.
